{% autoescape false -%}
{% macro entries(items, parents=[]) -%}
{% for item in items -%}
{% if item.is_section -%}
{{ entries(item.children, parents + [item.title]) }}
{%- elif item.is_link or item.file.inclusion.is_included() -%}
- [{{ (parents + [item.title]) | join(' / ') | replace('\\', '\\\\') | replace('[', '\\[') | replace(']', '\\]') }}]({{ item.url }}){% if item.is_page and item.meta.description %}: {{ item.meta.description.split() | join(' ') }}{% endif %}
{% endif -%}
{% endfor -%}
{% endmacro -%}
# {{ config.site_description }}

> Index of documentation pages for this AVD version.

{% for item in nav -%}
{% set links = entries(item.children if item.is_section else [item]) -%}
{% if links.strip() -%}
## {{ item.title }}

{{ links }}
{% endif -%}
{% endfor -%}
{% endautoescape -%}
